messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty INC123456 fired - Rate Limiter Quota Anomaly (prod). Alert: sustained 429 spike across prod-east and prod-west, tied to quota-mapper responses. Paging SRE primary.

pagerduty-bot: INC123456 auto-escalation: assigned to @sre-oncall (primary).

sre-oncall: ack — I'm on it. Starting triage: checking limiter health, quota-mapper, and recent deploys.

zoe: seeing 429s for a subset of tenants (tenant_id prefix: t-9*). Dashboard: http://grafana/redwood/rl/errors heatmap. spike started ~08:02 UTC. Some requests show downstream 500s from quota-mapper.

matt: checking deploy history — quota-mapper had a hotfix rolled yesterday at 02:15 UTC, image tag qm:2026-03-12-hotfix. No further rollouts.

eng-runtime: I pushed a config tweak to quota-mapper yesterday to flip `enforce_missing_quota=true` (was false previously) to tighten policy. Will validate the flag.

alex: metric snippets: `token_rate_limiter_429_count` went from ~20/min to ~1200/min; `quota_mapper_500_count` up 350%. Top-ten tenants by 429 are the usual traffic ones plus many new mobile keys.

maya: can we temporarily stop enforcing missing-quota to reduce customer impact? If enforcement is buggy it's causing cascaded 429s.

sre-oncall: agreed. Trying a soft rollback: toggle feature flag in config-store to `enforce_missing_quota=false`. Pushing now.

eng-runtime: i pushed the flag rollback to config-store (kv: `/features/quota-mapper/enforce_missing_quota=false`) and triggered a config refresh.

sre-oncall: confirming command run —
```
# example: refresh config on quota-mapper deployment
kubectl exec -n prod $(kubectl get pods -n prod -l app=quota-mapper -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.name}') -- /bin/sh -c 'curl -X POST http://localhost:8080/-/reload'
```

sre-oncall: config reload triggered. Watching metrics.

zoe: 429 rate dropping in prod-east, ingestion latency improving. Partial recovery seen in 2 mins.

alex: `quota_mapper_500_count` reduced to baseline within 4 mins. `token_rate_limiter_429_count` back to ~30/min.

pagerduty-bot: INC123456 acknowledged by sre-oncall — escalation paused.

matt: what caused the enforcement flip? eng-runtime said it was set to true yesterday — was that intentional?

eng-runtime: that change went in as part of a safety hardening PR (https://git.internal/redwood/qm/pull/456). Intention was to reduce silent overage, but we didn't fully exercise a migration path for tenants without quota metadata.

maya: customer impact: several high-traffic tenants saw client errors for ~6-8 minutes. We have 23 support tickets opened; CSM pinged. No billing surprises yet but need postmortem.

sre-oncall: immediate mitigation done (feature flag rollback). Next steps: 1) roll back quota-mapper image to previous stable tag if any residual errors, 2) add defensive check in quota-mapper to treat missing quota as soft fail (allow) by default, 3) add test to CI to simulate missing-quota tenant responses. Assign owners.

eng-runtime: I'll open a rollback PR and prepare the previous image tag rollback.

matt: i'll coordinate postmortem doc and impact timeline. tagging follow-ups: @eng-runtime (owner), @sre-oncall (incident owner), @alex (metrics), @zoe (support liaison).

pagerduty-bot: INC123456 status: mitigation applied; monitoring window started.

zoe: support note drafted: "We observed transient 429s affecting a subset of tenants due to strict quota enforcement. We've rolled back the enforcement flag and are monitoring. No data loss; SRE working on fix." Sending to CSM.

sre-oncall: monitoring through 09:00 UTC, if stable we'll close page then create follow-up task for code changes and tests. Leaving a runbook checklist:
- Confirmed rollback flag applied
- Watch error/latency graphs for 30m
- Confirmed no new 5xxs from quota-mapper
- Create postmortem ticket (P0 -> P2 depending on impact)

eng-runtime: creating ticket RED-INC-2390001234 in tracker with root cause hypothesis and steps to reproduce.

matt: noted extent of customer impact for postmortem: 23 tickets, 4 customers reported user-visible outages, 2 recoveries required client retries.

pagerduty-bot: INC123456 automatically resolved (mitigated) by pager within 24 minutes of firing.

sre-oncall: closing Slack thread for live mitigation. We will reconvene in a postmortem meeting 48hrs later. Thanks all for the quick responses :thumbsup:.

zoe: +1, will follow up with support bundle and affected tenant IDs.

eng-runtime: will prepare a PR to add a safe default and unit tests for missing-quota behavior.

alex: will schedule an alert tuning to avoid noisy pages for transient config flips; set threshold to trigger on sustained 5m increase at 10x baseline.

matt: postmortem owner assigned to me. I'll include timeline, root cause, mitigations, and action items.

incident-bot: Note: incident thread ended — recording participants and actions to RED-INC-2390001234.
